_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fsi#2 and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry claimed that missing ALE Dirichlet conditions produce inverted elements within ~5-20 steps and a 'det(J) < 0' abort from the ALE solver. Deleting both DESIGN SURF ALE DIRICH CONDITIONS and DESIGN VOL ALE DIRICH CONDITIONS from upstream fsi_fp_mono_fs_ga_ga.4C.yaml runs all 10 time steps (DRIFTING_TIME_STEPS_RUN=10) with zero Jacobian complaints and zero ALE warnings of any kind. The run ends on the deck's own result test -- 'Result check failed with 4 errors out of 6 tests' -- and the decisive numbers are the FSI Lagrange multipliers at interface node 16, which collapse from -5.50e-01 / -8.00e-01 / -8.00e-01 to order 1e-13, i.e. the interface transmits no force, while fluid pressure at node 16 moves from 4 to 6. The failure mode is a silently wrong answer, not an abort. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, git 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: Result check failed with 4 errors out of 6 tests

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep both ALE Dirichlet blocks. The bad arm becomes a copy of the working deck, DRIFTING_ALE_DIRICH_BLOCKS becomes 2, the result test passes and EXIT_DRIFTING becomes 0 (a forbidden token), so the fixture must go red.
